capabilities.justification: The public collect API defaults an omitted clock to monotonic_nanoseconds, which reads std::chrono::steady_clock.
The driver writes reports/help to std::cout and failures to std::cerr; the taxonomy unifies both under stdout.write.

justification: Unsigned proposal for the existing C++ library-plus-driver package. CLI argv and compile-time platform macros do not constitute environment-variable reads; build toolchain execution is not part of the shipped runtime boundary.
